details:
Some users who use my avatars have reported that the avatars jaw clips into the upper part of the mouth at rest when using selfie expression. It appears to be driving the aa into the negatives? This shouldnt be possible and looks really broken. 

Methods I've used to try to fix it:

Removing the jaw bone. The jaw bone wasnt used in the humanoid avatar anyway, but I had it in there for animating the visemes in the first place. Removing it made no difference

Remaking the Sil shape as a completely brand new and empty blendshape. This also did nothing, the problem persists. 

Uploading an avi with no other animation layers, JUST the avatar descriptor and its visemes. No dice there either. 

For some avatars it appears worse than others, and it seems to happen more with older cameras. I beleive there should be documentation provided for us creators, as there is little to no info on how the selfie expression actually functions.
title: Selfie expression appears to be producing negative viseme values
